purpose: Evaluate declared detector and estimator roles on verified economic-series cohorts with controlled permanent mean-shift injections and independent synthetic null traces. This is not a forecast-accuracy test and does not authorize production use.

cohort_selection_binding.interpretation: This artifact proves deterministic selection and identity binding only. It does not prove calibration, rearm measurement, detector performance, or Pilot execution. Its historical protocol binding is preserved and is not rewritten to match this revised execution protocol.

C1.definition: 147 GEM series whose stored production G1 composite screen status is SCREEN_FAIL
C1.criterion: ADF p<0.05 AND KPSS p>=0.05 are both required to pass G1
C1.pilot_selection: Deterministic stratified selection by G1 failure class, then observation length and pre-break AR1 dependence; minimum sample representation is 6 ADF-pass/KPSS-fail, 6 both-fail, and 2 ADF-fail/KPSS-pass. Exact IDs remain frozen in cohort_manifest.json.

pre_registered_power_analysis.interpretation_guard: Series is the independent unit; 18 nested injections are not 18 independent observations. Stratum 9 cannot independently decide acceptance or rejection.

C2.sampling: Deterministic stratified sample by source cohort, domain, length band and pre-break AR dependence band; fixed IDs and seed ledger in cohort_manifest.json
C2.stratification_report: C2_STRATIFICATION_REPORT_V1 must publish distributions for all five dimensions separately for the 50-series sample and its exact 20-series Pilot subset, plus source-by-length, source-by-AR1 and source-by-missingness cross-tabs.

sampling_frame_explanation.frame: C1 complement only, not the full 509-series universe
sampling_frame_explanation.construction: 509 verified economic series minus the 147 verified C1 GEM composite-screen failures
sampling_frame_explanation.interpretation: C2 tests generalization on the non-C1 complement. It deliberately does not sample C1 members and must not be described as representative of all 509 series.

focus_eligibility.rule: NOT_ELIGIBLE for FOCuS only; not a weak-recall outcome. Other detectors follow their own minimum-observation contract.

C2.scope_note: C2 is the stratified complement of C1 (362 = 311 GEM G1-pass + 51 Pink Sheet), not a representative sample of the full 509-series universe. It is retained as a generalization cohort reference, but the reduced FOCuS calibration-focused Track A is restricted to calibrated C1 series. No C2 performance conclusion is claimed by this reduced Pilot.

C3.required_evidence: Independent known-break event/series mapping plus point-in-time source vintages proving each historical observation was available at decision time

cohort_design.rule: Run only the 40 exact series IDs frozen in the cohort manifest. No silent replacements. If a selected series becomes ineligible, record the reason and maintain the planned coverage denominator.

selected_cohort_frame.interpretation: The 40-series / 760-case values describe the preserved C1/C2 selection frame only. They are not an executed Pilot and are not the execution scope of the C1-only partial Pilot.

baseline.rule: The first 40 observations are reserved for initial location/scale calibration and must not generate detection events.

injection_design.break_index_rule: floor(position_fraction * n), zero-based; the shift is applied from break_index through the final observation.
injection_design.sigma_reference: 1.4826 * MAD of residuals from the selected AR(p) model fitted only on the complete pre-break prefix.
injection_design.short_prebreak_rule: NOT_ELIGIBLE with a machine-readable reason for that position; preserve it in the planned-case and coverage denominators. Do not silently drop it or count it as a detector miss.
injection_design.direction_correct_detection: A true positive must have the correct sign and detection_index >= true_break_index. A pre-onset or wrong-direction event cannot be a true positive.
injection_design.rearm_exposure_rule: The first detector invocation reserves 40 initial observations. Following each confirmed FOCuS hit, the adapter reserves the next 20 observations for re-calibration. An injected break in that half-open interval is INVALID_INJECTION, not a detector false negative.

rearm_overlap_guard.overlap_rule: true_break_index is within [start_inclusive,end_exclusive) of a post-hit 20-observation rearm interval
rearm_overlap_guard.recall_accounting: exclude from recall numerator and denominator; retain in planned and invalid coverage counts
rearm_overlap_guard.non_overlap_outcome: evaluate normally as DETECTED or MISSED

empirical_overlap_measurement.method: For each C1 series and each planned position, run 1000 independent HOLDOUT AR(p) null traces through the frozen FOCuS threshold and 40/20 reset-rearm adapter. Count traces in which the planned break index falls inside a recorded post-hit half-open rearm interval.
empirical_overlap_measurement.interpretation: This is a null rearm-exposure diagnostic only. It is not injected-break recall, not an injection false-negative rate, and not a measured overlap result until a GitHub Actions artifact exists.

eligibility.reason: 40 initial calibration observations plus at least 110 observations available for detection evaluation
eligibility.below_minimum: FOCUS status NOT_ELIGIBLE with reason FOCUS_MIN_N_150_REQUIRED; do not record a low-recall result
eligibility.scope: FOCuS_RESET_ARL_PILOT only; other tools retain their own declared minimums

empirical_rate.note: No empirical rearm-overlap rate is established before an artifact-backed GitHub Actions run.

guard_window_policy.note: The policy is frozen; no empirical overlap rate is established until an artifact-backed run is published.

ar_null_and_calibration.order_selection: Minimum AIC among p=1,2,3, fitted on the complete pre-break prefix for the relevant injection position; selection is development-only and frozen before holdout.
ar_null_and_calibration.fit_scope: Use all available observations strictly before the injected break. Do not use the post-break suffix to estimate AR coefficients, intercept or residual scale.
ar_null_and_calibration.innovation_model: Parametric AR recursion with centered, independently resampled fitted residual innovations; record residual pool hash and deterministic seed. No injected break or regime transition is included in null traces.
ar_null_and_calibration.stability_gate: Reject non-finite or singular fits, insufficient residual degrees of freedom, and any fitted AR polynomial with a root not strictly outside the unit circle.
ar_null_and_calibration.failed_fit_status: NOT_ELIGIBLE with reason; no silent AR(1) fallback or model-order substitution.

tool_scope.rationale: BOCPD is evaluated as a posterior feature generator, not an independent binary detector. Running 2000 AR null traces at every position for every series would create a large quadratic posterior workload without a valid BOCPD alarm threshold.

ar_null_and_calibration.deterministic_seeds: SHA-256-derived independent streams over protocol version, series ID, position, selected AR order, tool/scale variant, phase and replicate index. Development and holdout seeds must not overlap.

synthetic_null_fpr.definition: P0 = P(at least one false alarm within the exact original series horizon) estimated from independent parametric AR(p) null traces.
synthetic_null_fpr.calculation: alarm traces / valid null traces; report per-series and by cohort with Wilson intervals.
synthetic_null_fpr.threshold_selection: For each series, position and online tool, choose the least sensitive threshold whose one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound on development P0 is <= 0.10. Freeze before holdout or injections.
synthetic_null_fpr.holdout: Evaluate the frozen threshold on 1000 independent holdout traces; no recalibration or threshold selection on holdout.
synthetic_null_fpr.invalid_replicates: Report separately; below 950 valid traces makes that condition INCONCLUSIVE.

arl0.method: Empirical time-to-first-false-alarm with right-censoring at the actual series horizon; report restricted mean run length and censoring fraction.
arl0.rule: A target beyond the available horizon is NOT_ESTIMABLE. Never infer P0 from 1/ARL0 and never use ARL0 as a substitute for series-horizon P0.

shuffle_null.purpose: Negative-control diagnostic; preserves marginal values while destroying temporal order.
shuffle_null.acceptance_role: Diagnostic only; not a substitute for the fitted AR(p) null.

ar_null_and_calibration.null_seed_streams: SHA-256-derived streams over protocol version, series ID, position, selected AR order, phase and replicate index. The base AR null paths are shared across candidate tools; MAD and Bartlett variants receive identical paths for paired comparison. Development and holdout streams never overlap.
ar_null_and_calibration.threshold_grid_rule: Evaluate thresholds in ascending numeric order on the same development null traces. Select the lowest threshold whose one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for P0 is <=0.10. If none qualifies, mark NOT_CALIBRATABLE/INCONCLUSIVE; do not extend the grid after seeing holdout.
ar_null_and_calibration.paired_paths_rule: For each series-position-AR(p)-phase-replicate, generate one deterministic null path and reuse it across FOCuS, Huber MAD, Huber Bartlett, BOCPD and R-FPOP as appropriate. MAD and Bartlett thresholds are estimated independently on these identical paths.

original_alarm_burden.definition: Count and timing of alarms on the unmodified original series under the frozen detector configuration.
original_alarm_burden.interpretation: Descriptive burden only; original real-data events are not independently adjudicated, so these alarms are not labelled false positives.

original_r_fpop_burden.definition: Number and positions of retrospective breakpoints on the unmodified original series.
original_r_fpop_burden.interpretation: Descriptive segmentation burden only; never an online alarm or false-positive rate.

alarm_burden_ratio.definition: Original online alarm count divided by the expected alarm count on matched synthetic AR(p) null traces for the same series and horizon.
alarm_burden_ratio.interpretation: Model-misspecification diagnostic only; not an automatic pass/fail rule.

measurements.synthetic_null_fpr: Keep separate from original alarm burden; report P0 per series and cohort with Wilson confidence intervals.

injection_recall.definition: Direction-correct detections at or after the injected break divided by eligible injected cases.
injection_recall.false_negatives: Every eligible injected case with no direction-correct detection by series end remains a false negative in the denominator.
injection_recall.pre_onset: Record separately; cannot count as a true positive.
injection_recall.wrong_direction: Record wrong-sign detections after the injected break separately; do not credit them as recall.

invalid_injection.definition: Planned injected case whose true break falls inside a FOCuS reset/re-arm calibration interval
invalid_injection.recall_accounting: Exclude from detector recall numerator and denominator; report separately in coverage and never count as a false negative

detection_delay.definition: detection_index - true_break_index for direction-correct detected injections only.
detection_delay.missed_cases: Report separately; do not hide misses by assigning them a zero delay.

coverage.definition: Report planned, eligible, NOT_ELIGIBLE, abstained and executed counts by cohort, series, position, magnitude, direction and tool.
coverage.denominator_rule: Always publish numerator and denominator; do not silently remove short or failed cases.
coverage.invalid_injection_rule: Retain invalid injection cases in the planned denominator, report their count separately, and exclude them only from the Injection Recall denominator; never recode as detector misses.

series_variability.cv_rule: SD(per-series recall) / mean(per-series recall); report UNDEFINED when the mean is zero.

minimum_detectable_effect.definition: Operational MDE is the smallest tested shift magnitude whose series-clustered 95% lower confidence bound for direction-correct detection probability reaches 0.80 (80% empirical detection power).
minimum_detectable_effect.if_unreached: Report >2.0 sigma; do not extrapolate beyond the tested grid.
minimum_detectable_effect.not_classical_claim: This is empirical detector power on the declared cohorts, not a claim about power for an external scientific hypothesis test.

cost_weighted_diagnostic.normalized_mean_delay: Mean correct-detection delay divided by the exact series horizon n; values are within [0,1]. Report UNDEFINED when no injected case was detected.
cost_weighted_diagnostic.role: Secondary comparison only; cannot override a mandatory safety, coverage, P0 or holdout gate.

confidence_intervals.series_metrics: Cluster bootstrap by series ID, resampling each series together with all its 19 conditions; 2000 replicates; 95% intervals.
confidence_intervals.null_probability: Wilson score interval, 95%, over valid independent null replicates, then report the distribution across series.
confidence_intervals.permutation: Paired sign-flip permutation at the series level, never at the observation/time-point level.

FOCuS.first_hit_engine_limitation: Resolved by the P1.4 reset/rearm adapter: initial invocation uses 40 observations; post-hit invocations recalibrate with the next 20 observations.
FOCuS.reset_policy: Use 40 observations for initial calibration. After every confirmed hit, reset functional-pruning state and reserve the next 20 observations as the new calibration/rearm interval. Record its exact half-open start/end and exposure. If an injected break falls inside the interval, mark INVALID_INJECTION and exclude it from Recall numerator and denominator; do not count it as a false negative.
FOCuS.per_series_threshold: Use the threshold selected only from development AR(p) null traces for the same series and position.

minimum_series_length.components: 40 initial calibration observations plus at least 110 detection observations
minimum_series_length.below_minimum: NOT_ELIGIBLE, not a weak detection result

POST_QUIET_HUBER_MAD.calibration: First 40 observations only; per-series/per-position threshold chosen on development AR(p) null traces.

POST_QUIET_HUBER_BARTLETT.comparison: Same Huber detector, same AR(p) traces, same P0 target, same data positions; MAD and Bartlett scale variants independently calibrate thresholds on development data only.

primary_success.calibration_error_improvement: Reduce absolute holdout |P0_actual - 0.10| by at least 30% relative to MAD.
primary_success.recall_noninferiority: Recall at 1 sigma may not fall by more than 0.10 absolute versus MAD.
primary_success.restriction: Do not claim a 20% FPR reduction when both variants are calibrated to the same target P0.

Bartlett_LRV.comparison_scope: Only a scale estimator inside the Huber Bartlett variant (and a separately identified A_FAST_BARTLETT_PILOT if implemented).
Bartlett_LRV.forbidden: Standalone detector, standalone hit generator, or direct pass/fail role.

BOCPD.required_output: Full posterior P(run_length_t | observations through t) for every evaluated prefix; preserve run-length support and normalized posterior mass.
BOCPD.current_engine_blocker: Current P2-C runner exposes only posterior summaries/diagnostic tail, not the complete posterior distribution for every prefix. Full PMF export is a pre-Pilot implementation gate.
BOCPD.posterior_only_decision_rule: For diagnostic comparison only, short_run_probability >= 0.35 for at least 3 of 5 consecutive prefixes; this is not a production BOCPD binary-detector authorization.

incremental_value_test.method: Paired, series-level permutation test over the 40 independent series clusters; injection cases are kept nested within their series.
incremental_value_test.effect_size: Cohen's dz on paired per-series differences in direction-correct injection recall and separately in filtered false-alarm P0.
incremental_value_test.fusion: A FOCuS candidate is retained only when BOCPD short-run posterior mass is >=0.35 on at least 3 of 5 evaluated prefixes within +/-3 observations of the FOCuS detection index. Otherwise the candidate is not corroborated.
incremental_value_test.success: Corroboration reduces holdout P0 by >=0.05 absolute on the identical FOCuS null bank while limiting recall loss to <=0.10 absolute, with paired series-level p<0.05. BOCPD-only diagnostic is assessed for feature association with injected changes versus shuffled controls, not FPR.
incremental_value_test.feature_diagnostic: Report posterior-feature separation by per-series injection condition and shuffled control. No online warning, P0, ARL0, or production-detector claim is allowed from BOCPD-only.
incremental_value_test.forecast_value: Not tested in P1.4; predictive value is deferred to Engine 2 rolling-origin validation.

execution_scope.run_on_cases: All original and 18 injected conditions for each of the 40 selected series (760 traces total).
execution_scope.shuffle_diagnostic: 250 within-series shuffled controls per selected series; feature diagnostics only, no operational FPR claim.
execution_scope.p0_calibration: No independent BOCPD threshold calibration and no standalone P0/ARL0 claim.
execution_scope.fusion_null_check: For each calibrated FOCuS development/holdout AR null trace, first run the FOCuS reset/rearm path. Only when FOCuS emits an alarm is BOCPD replayed to the candidate detection prefix to assess the predeclared corroboration rule. The fused false-alarm count is measured on the same complete FOCuS null bank; traces with no FOCuS candidate remain non-alarms.
execution_scope.feature_pmf_export: Persist a deterministic hash of the complete per-prefix posterior PMF trace. The artifact stores summary metrics and replay metadata; the PMF is recomputed from the frozen trace during replay, avoiding raw-observation or unbounded per-trace artifact growth.

matching.rule: One-to-one assignment between the single injected break and at most one estimated breakpoint; choose the closest candidate inside the tolerance, with deterministic tie-break by lower index.
matching.extra_boundaries: Every non-matched breakpoint is a false breakpoint.
matching.boundary_precision: Matched injected boundaries / all estimated boundaries; zero if no estimated boundaries.
matching.boundary_recall: Matched injected boundaries / one injected boundary.

penalty_calibration.rule: On development AR(p) null traces only, choose the smallest penalty multiplier whose one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for P(any breakpoint) is <=0.10.
penalty_calibration.freeze: Freeze penalty per series before holdout; never adjust after holdout or injected outcomes are inspected.

null_control.source: Same independent development and holdout AR(p) parametric null traces used by the detector calibration framework.
null_control.rule: No uncalibrated random number of segmentation boundaries may be used as the null baseline.

primary_success.false_breakpoint_burden: Holdout null upper 95% Wilson bound on P(any breakpoint) <= 0.10
primary_success.interpretation: Retrospective segmentation only; never treat estimated boundary as an online warning.

references.A_FAST: Frozen reference control; no code or threshold changes and no tuning on Pilot/holdout.
references.A_CONSENSUS: Frozen reference control; no code or threshold changes and no tuning on Pilot/holdout.

decision_rules.confidence_intervals: Use series-cluster bootstrap (2000 replicates) for recall, delay, MDE and variability. Use Wilson intervals for independent null replicates. Use paired series-level permutation for BOCPD feature value.
decision_rules.pass: A tool passes only when all mandatory limits for its assigned role are met using the predeclared confidence bound on both C1 and C2 separately.
decision_rules.fail: A tool fails only when the corresponding interval lies wholly on the failing side of a predeclared threshold with at least 80% planned series/conditions eligible and >=950 valid null replicates.
decision_rules.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE when confidence intervals cross a threshold, fewer than 80% of planned conditions are eligible, fewer than 950 valid null traces exist, or a required implementation/trace is missing.

cohort_decisions.VALIDATED: At least one candidate passes its declared role on both C1 and C2, all mandatory integrity/causal gates pass, and the resulting operating envelope is restricted to the tested cohorts and conditions. C3 remains visibly pending.
cohort_decisions.LOCKED_REJECTED: All candidate tools fail their assigned roles on both C1 and C2 with adequate eligible coverage and confidence intervals wholly on the failing side. Preserve negative evidence; do not retune and rerun the same hypothesis.
cohort_decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Coverage, implementation, null calibration or statistical precision is insufficient for either validation or rejection.

C1_ONLY_PARTIAL.description: A C1-only partial Pilot may report implementation, calibration, coverage, and per-series evidence for the artifact-backed eligible subset only.
restrictions: Must not be labeled VALIDATED or LOCKED_REJECTED.
Must not claim C2 validation or generalization.
Must not promote a detector to production.
Must report the exact eligible and executed series IDs, counts, invalid injections, misses, and exclusions from source artifacts.

decision_rules.after_holdout: No recalibration, threshold changes, penalty changes, model-order reselection, cohort replacement, or metric changes after holdout inspection.
decision_rules.negative_result_policy: A valid FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE result is accepted. Never modify criteria to obtain a pass.

execution.matrix: One matrix job per selected series. Each job executes the original baseline and all 18 injected cases for that series. Each series-position null bank is generated once per development/holdout phase and reused across candidate arms; paired variants never receive different null paths.
execution.required_preflight_gates: C1 identities and composite G1 breakdown must be bound to the verified cohort-selection artifact.;C2 complement frame and stratification report must be bound to the verified cohort-selection artifact.;Run real threshold-90 calibration on all 20 C1 pilot series and publish P0, Wilson upper bound, actual threshold, seed ledger and source artifact hashes.;Run the one-time threshold-200 extension only on the stratum-106 and stratum-32 series identified as not calibrated by the real threshold-90 artifact; publish separate artifact-backed results.;Track B no-injection diagnostics must be generated from original pinned series and include the pre-registered metrics; no post-hoc parameter changes.;FOCuS runtime enforces min_n_for_focus=150; n<150 returns NOT_ELIGIBLE.;FOCuS rearm contract uses 40 initial and 20 post-hit observations; empirical overlap must be measured and INVALID_INJECTION excluded from Recall, never FN.;Capability/protocol/runtime contract tests pass on the exact source commit.;No Pilot PASS without pilot_run_manifest.json, per-series seed ledger, replay_command, and SHA-256 for every original artifact.;C3 remains pending until independent known-break mappings and point-in-time source-vintage evidence exist.
execution.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 each per-series artifact and posterior PMF artifact before upload. Aggregate only the exact frozen series IDs and verify all files/hashes.
execution.replay: Every per-series output includes deterministic replay command and exact source, model, tool version, protocol SHA and seed identities.
execution.pilot_start_gate: PILOT NOT STARTED. Dispatch only after the implementation, contract tests, and artifact lineage gates are ready. Threshold-90 calibration covers the 20 frozen C1 candidates. Threshold 200 is applied once, only at position 0.30, to artifact-derived Stratum-106 failures, reusing the same threshold-90 development null max-statistics. Track B is limited to artifact-derived non-calibratable C1 series. Pilot execution is C1-only, at most 15 eligible series / 285 cases. C2 remains a frozen generalization reference and is not part of this partial Pilot.
execution.seed_rule: Seed identity excludes tool/scale variant so paired arms receive identical stochastic inputs; separate streams are keyed by protocol, series, position, AR order, phase and replicate.

implementation_time_budget.deadline_action: If the full runner/matrix is not ready within 24 hours, use the predeclared partial Pilot; do not expand the runner indefinitely.

partial_fallback.selection: Artifact-calibrated C1 series only, selected from the exact frozen C1 IDs. No C2 series, substitutions, or uncalibrated series. If fewer than 15 qualify, report the smaller actual count.
partial_fallback.interpretation: Partial engineering and coverage evidence on C1 only; cannot establish full-cohort VALIDATED or LOCKED_REJECTED status and cannot support a C2 or production claim.

track_A.name: C1_ONLY_ARTIFACT_CALIBRATED_INJECTION_TRACK
track_A.series_ids: The exact 20 C1 IDs in the frozen cohort manifest; include only artifact-calibrated series, with a hard maximum of 15. Derive eligibility from the real calibration artifacts. No substitutions.
track_A.rule: Pilot is C1-only. Select at most 15 eligible C1 series from the frozen selected IDs after threshold-90 calibration and the permitted Stratum-106 threshold-200 extension. If fewer than 15 are eligible, execute only that smaller set. Each executed series has one original case and 18 planned injections.

track_B.name: NON_CALIBRATABLE_NO_INJECTION_DIAGNOSTIC
track_B.target_selection: All C1 Pilot series classified NOT_CALIBRATABLE after the permitted threshold-90 and one-time threshold-200 steps. Exact IDs must be sourced from calibration_results_all_strata.json generated by a GitHub Actions run.
measurements: AR persistence/order and AR(1) coefficient on the pre-break prefix
Gaussian GARCH(1,1) MLE on pre-break AR residuals; convergence and alpha+beta; NOT_ESTIMABLE if fit fails
ARCH-LM diagnostic on pre-break AR residuals
unlabelled FOCuS candidate alerts on the unmodified prefix; not adjudicated historical breaks
P50/P90/P95/P99/P99.9/max and threshold exceedance counts from the 1000 deterministic AR(p) null max-statistics

diagnostic_tracks.overlap_between_tracks: A series may have a no-injection diagnostic record and a distinct injected Track A record; do not treat those records as independent series.

pre_registered_grid_extension.purpose: One-time extension test for the pre-registered C1 Stratum-106 subset that fails genuine threshold-90 calibration.

stratum_106.target: Only C1 ADF_PASS_KPSS_FAIL / Stratum-106 series whose own artifact-backed threshold-90 calibration fails at position 0.30.
stratum_106.actual_series_ids_source: Derive exact IDs from the threshold-90 calibration artifact; never hardcode, replace, or force the expected count.
stratum_106.max_statistics_reuse: Reuse the exact position-0.30 development Null max-statistics generated and stored by the threshold-90 run for each eligible series. Do not regenerate null traces, change AR order, or alter seed identities.

decision_rule.count_mismatch: Preserve and report the actual artifact-derived count even when it differs from the pre-registered expected count of seven; never force seven.
decision_rule.stop: No threshold 500, intermediate thresholds, AR-order replacement, residual-bootstrap change, P0 relaxation, or cohort replacement.

track_b_protocol.targets: Only C1 series that remain NOT_CALIBRATABLE after the applicable permitted calibration steps. For Stratum-106, this includes its one-time threshold-200 result. For other strata, do not apply threshold 200. Exact IDs and counts must be derived from the original threshold-calibration artifacts.

measurements.name: AR persistence
measurements.definition: Selected AR(p) order and AR(1) coefficient from the same pre-break prefix used for calibration.

measurements.name: GARCH(1,1)
measurements.definition: Fit a Gaussian GARCH(1,1) to the pre-break AR residuals only; record omega, alpha, beta, alpha+beta, convergence and standard errors. If the estimator is unavailable or fails convergence, report NOT_ESTIMABLE; no proxy is relabeled GARCH.

measurements.name: Seasonality
measurements.definition: Raw-series and pre-break AR-residual autocorrelation at lag 12.

measurements.name: Trend
measurements.definition: OLS linear slope over the pre-break prefix, normalized as slope*n/std(series).

measurements.name: Historical-break candidates
measurements.definition: Unlabelled FOCuS candidate events on each unmodified original C1 series; these are not adjudicated historical breaks, not verified event truth, and not C3 evidence.

measurements.name: FOCuS null-statistic distribution
measurements.definition: From the same 1000 deterministic AR(p) development null max-statistics used by threshold-90 calibration, persist P50, P90, P95, P99, P99.9, maximum, and exceedance counts at permitted thresholds. No new threshold is selected from Track B.

track_b_protocol.conclusion_rule: Track B can describe associations and model-limit indicators only. It cannot change the null model, AR order, P0 target, threshold ceiling or cohort membership.
track_b_protocol.selection_source: Artifact-derived calibration status only; no fixed IDs, presumed calibrated counts, or hand-authored comparison groups.

pilot_scope_change.reason: The Pilot is limited to up to 15 artifact-calibrated C1 series. The actual execution count is determined only by genuine threshold calibration artifacts.
pilot_scope_change.track_b: All and only C1 series actually NOT_CALIBRATABLE after their applicable permitted calibration steps; count and IDs NOT_RUN.
pilot_scope_change.impact: No Pilot eligible-series count, injection recall, calibration status, or empirical overlap rate is established before the original GitHub Actions artifacts exist.
